historicalBoundary: Only known INACTIVE nonowner nonself lower-role targets in fixed PATCH/DELETE, no activation/User creation. Actual application CUID creation does not reuse opaque IDs; manual DB replacement/writers outside this lock protocol are not a claim of global retirement safety.
